requirements.requirement: The system must render recruiting status before any other triage or quality information in the MessageBubble component.
The system must render condition match immediately after recruiting status and before any quality metrics.
The system must display a clear pass or fail indicator for triage results using a distinct visual element.
The system must render a human-readable explanation string describing why the trial passed or failed triage.
The system must ensure triage explanation content is displayed before any quality score or secondary metrics in the UI.
The system must format recruiting status and condition match values into user-friendly text labels (e.g., "Recruiting", "Not Recruiting", "Matches Condition").
The system must preserve the ordering defined in the S1 triage display contract when rendering all triage fields.
The system must gracefully omit any missing optional triage fields without breaking the MessageBubble layout.
The system must display a fallback message when the explanation text is missing, indicating that detailed reasoning is unavailable.
The system must correctly render triage results when pass/fail is false, ensuring failure reasons are still shown prominently.
The system must ensure that any AI-generated explanation text is displayed exactly as provided without truncation or reordering.
The system must prevent rendering of triage UI if the input does not conform to the S1 contract schema and instead log an error.
The system must render triage explanation content within the existing MessageBubble component without introducing a new container component.
The system must ensure consistent spacing and visual grouping between recruiting status, condition match, and explanation text.
